test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: The Cabinet approved three multitracking railway projects worth Rs 9,072 crore in February 2026 covering which four states?​

options.text: Bihar, Odisha, Jharkhand and West Bengal
Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar and Jharkhand
Maharashtra, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh
Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal

solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar and Jharkhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

 
• **The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved three multitracking railway projects on 24 February 2026 across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar and Jharkhand.**
 
• **The total approved cost of the projects is approximately ₹9,072 crore.**
